Apple is where we use the power of technology to enrich people's lives. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something.
Join the Apple Ads Engineering team and help build an advertising platform that benefits both customers and advertisers. Our technology makes advertising possible on the App Store, Apple News, Stocks, and Apple TV — helping people discover content, supporting creators and publishers, and connecting advertisers of all sizes with engaged audiences, all with the unwavering commitment to privacy you expect from Apple. In this role, you will design, develop, and launch the highly-performant, internet-scale backend systems that select and deliver the right ads in real time, collaborating across engineering, product, and infrastructure to bring elegant solutions into production at Apple scale.
You will design, develop, and operate the distributed services that make real-time ad selection possible at Apple. You will architect and build low-latency, high-availability, high-throughput ad-serving systems in a cloud environment, engineer secure and scalable data processing pipelines that operate on petabyte-scale datasets, and implement performant services that handle very high data volumes and QPS. You will work cross-functionally to ensure that optimal and correct ads are available for real-time selection, and that observability and flexibility are provided for stakeholders. While this role focuses on the candidate retrieval part of Apple Ads, we are not constrained by organization structure and offer the flexibility to contribute across a variety of backend systems, including opportunities to apply algorithmic search, machine learning, NLP, and AI to hard retrieval problems. You will write clean, efficient, well-documented code, participate in code reviews, and mentor other engineers on the team. Collaboration with internal partners across indexing, search, serving, operations, and program management to define requirements and deliver high-quality solutions is essential. You should be passionate about building products that protect user privacy and thrive in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities — and have fun doing it.
Architect, design, and implement internet-scale, low-latency, highly-available ad-serving systems in a cloud environment.
Build performant micro-services and distributed data platforms that support high data volumes and QPS.
Engineer secure, scalable distributed data processing pipelines capable of processing petabyte-scale datasets for indexing and retrieval.
Apply techniques from algorithmic search, machine learning, natural language processing, and AI to advance candidate retrieval and ranking.
Collaborate with multiple internal teams to support indexing and searching use cases across the organization.
Partner with product managers, operations, SREs, and fellow engineers to define requirements and deliver end-to-end systems.
Work effectively both independently and as part of a team to deliver complete systems from design through production.
Write clean, efficient, well-documented code and participates in code reviews.
Debug and resolve complex issues across large-scale distributed systems.
Stay current with advances in search, retrieval, distributed systems, ML/AI, and cloud infrastructure, and contribute ideas that improve the platform.
Minimum Qualifications
Masters in CS with 1 year of industry experience
Strong background in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.
Strong coding skills in Go, Java, Rust, C++, Scala, or a similar OOP/Functional language.
Hands-on experience designing and operating scalable micro-services.
Experience with AWS services such as Amazon S3, EC2, and EKS/Kubernetes. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
Demonstrated ability to work on complex problems and systems, alone or as part of a team, to deliver complete systems end to end.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical cross-functional teams, including operations and project management partners.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building ad-serving, recommendation, or large-scale retrieval systems.
Familiarity with real-time bidding, candidate retrieval, or ranking pipelines.
Experience operating services with strict latency and availability SLOs.
Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals — consensus, replication, and fault tolerance.
A desire to work in a fast-paced and challenging environment, and a fast learner with strong motivation for growing and learning new technologies.

The base pay range for this role is between $129,300 and $194,700, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people's lives. Our Apple Ads group makes it possible for people around the world to easily access informative and imaginative content on their devices while helping publishers and developers promote and monetize their work. Today, our technology and services power advertising in the App Store, Apple Maps, and Apple News. Our platforms are highly-performant, deployed at scale, and setting new standards for enabling effective advertising while protecting user privacy.
The Apple Ads Machine Learning Platform team's mission is to empower Ads teams to build and scale the innovative ML systems that deliver highly optimized advertising content to consumers. Are you a results-oriented and versatile engineer who can excel in a fast-paced environment? You will work closely with ML engineers and scientists to design, develop, and build world-class platform capabilities that will enable Ads teams to improve and scale our ML features, models, and applications.
The ML Platform team is responsible for bringing numerous features to advertisers and consumers while simultaneously supporting scalable modeling and continuous experimentation by all Ads teams. As a key contributor to this team, you will design and develop secure and scalable back-end systems. You will enjoy building high-performing, elegant systems from the ground up, in close partnerships with various teams. You will also possess keen judgment in selecting technologies and building the right solutions for the unique ad network challenges we face. You will play a meaningful role building machine learning products which deliver on Apple's privacy commitments and change the way advertising works with data.
Join us and contribute to a culture that emphasizes reliability, simplicity, and scalability. You will join a team of world-class machine learning engineers hungry to apply leading-edge technologies to deliver extraordinary experiences to our customers. We are one team, nurturing each other's growth and supporting each other in delivering for our customers!
Experience writing mission-critical code for production machine learning systems
Experience building ML infrastructure, frameworks or services used by multiple teams
Experience building SDKs, API, and automation UIs used by development teams
Experience building automation and CI/CD

Working knowledge of deep learning architectures and training frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
Strong problem solving, debugging and performance tuning skills
Results oriented, with the ability to communicate effectively, both written and verbal, with technical and non-technical multi-functional teams
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience applying ML at scale in advertising, recommender systems, information retrieval or related domains
Experience in advertising industry
Good understanding of model evaluation, train-serve skew and data drift
Product-minded with a proven ability to seek projects with a sense of ownership
Experience with distributed training and/or optimizing large-scale models for low-latency serving
Experience building infrastructure for diverse sets of model development use cases including LLMs, multimodal models, classical ML, and reinforcement learning.
Experience building and/or operationalizing foundation models
Experience with agentic AI
Prior experience in privacy-preserving ML

We’re starting to see the incredible potential of multimodal foundation and large language models, and many applications in the computer vision and machine learning domain that previously appeared infeasible are now within reach. We are looking for a highly motivated and skilled Applied Machine Learning Research Engineer to join our team in the Video Computer Vision group and help us push the boundaries of human understanding. The Video Computer Vision org has pioneered human-centric real-time features such as FaceID, FaceKit, and Gaze and Hand gesture control which have changed the way millions of users interact with their devices. We balance research and product requirements to deliver Apple quality, pioneering experiences, innovating through the full stack, and partnering with HW, SW and AI teams to shape Apple's products and bring our vision to life.
In this role, you will drive ground breaking development at the intersection of AI, generative modeling, and computer vision. You will work across the full lifecycle—from foundational investigation to practical applications—designing, implementing, and evaluating novel algorithms and models.
Your primary focus will be human understanding, including human motion, activities, and representation learning. A major aspect of the role involves designing, implementing, evaluating and productizing ML systems capable of human and activity understanding.
This position offers a unique opportunity to innovate, build, and ship: you will take your conceptual ideas to products that reach millions of users worldwide. You will collaborate with a diverse group of experts—research scientists, ML engineers, software engineers, data scientists, human-interface designers, and domain specialists—working in an environment that values experimentation, ownership, and continuous learning.
By staying at the forefront of advancements in AI, machine learning, and computer vision, you will play a direct role in driving innovation, influencing the evolution of Apple products, and meaningfully enhancing user experience on a global scale.
Minimum Qualifications
Strong experience developing machine learning models.
Proficiency in Python and solid software engineering fundamentals.
Experience with at least one deep learning framework (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, or equivalent).
Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, plus 3 years of relevant industry experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience training and deploying production-grade ML models.
Experience developing multimodal LLMs or generative models.
Production-level experience with a compiled language (e.g., Swift, C++).
Expertise in one or more areas: computer vision, machine learning, multimodal LLMs, Reinforcement Learning, Agentic AI.
PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with a focus on computer vision, machine learning, or multimodal systems.
Demonstrated problem-solving ability, strong sense of ownership and product shipment.

Join the Apple Service Engineering (ASE) team and drive innovation that matters! The ASE team builds and provides systems and infrastructure that fuel Apple's services. As part of this team, you will be responsible for building and integrating technologies that enhance people's lives. We are also tasked with enabling Apple Intelligence and Private Cloud Compute in the cloud. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead the shift from repository-based asset intake to a service-oriented platform that delivers client assets to server nodes across our data centers.
This role owns the end-to-end asset integration pipeline that moves assets from client teams to server nodes across Apple data centers. You will lead the transition from a repository-based workflow to microservices and RESTful APIs, own package builds and build-team automation, provide storage endpoints, and maintain the dashboards and alerts that keep the pipeline healthy. You will partner with client teams building on Large Language Models, so you need working fluency in ML concepts.
The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who can navigate fast-moving requirements while maintaining a long-term vision for resilient and scalable solutions.
Design and build microservices and RESTful APIs for asset intake, packaging, storage, and distribution to server nodes across data centers.
Lead the migration from repository-based asset management to a service-oriented architecture.
Own package build pipelines and coordinate automation with build teams.
Provide storage endpoints and clear onboarding paths for client teams.
Build and maintain monitoring dashboards and alerting mechanisms for pipeline health.
Develop internal tools (CLIs, microservice, automation pipelines, front end) to enhance developer experience.
Drive architectural decisions for the asset delivery platform, prioritizing reliability, observability, and ease of adoption.
Collaborate cross-functionally with product, security, and engineering teams, and with client teams, to understand asset requirements and align on technical direction.
Provide technical mentorship, elevate engineering standards, and set API and design standards for the platform.
Act as a systems thinker who can map how changes propagate across the platform, guiding teams toward resilient and future-proof approaches.
Navigate rapidly changing requirements and adapt plans swiftly without compromising long-term objectives.
Minimum Qualifications
7+ years of software engineering experience in building and operating production systems
Expert-level proficiency with programming languages such as Python or Java with production web services and RESTful API design
Experience designing and operating microservices, including services that run across multiple data centers, with the ability to reason about scale, concurrency, and failure modes
Proven experience designing and implementing internal tools, automation, and service-level components
Foundational understanding of machine learning and LLM concepts sufficient to work effectively with client teams
Ability to collaborate closely across teams and influence decisions through clarity, empathy, and technical depth
Comfortable working in dynamic, fast-changing environments where you help create structure, not wait for it
Experience building monitoring dashboards and alerting for services you own
Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related field
Preferred Qualifications
Working familiarity with containerization (Docker)
Experience with artifact registries, package managers, or object storage
Prior experience migrating a legacy workflow to a service-oriented architecture
Proficiency in complementary languages (C/C++, Shell, SQL)

The Human and Object Understanding (HOUr) team in the Intelligent System Experience (ISE) organization at Apple is Looking for ML research engineers in the space of advanced face understanding and analysis. This is an opportunity to join a team that built the enabling ML technologies behind a number of marquee products and features such as:
Visual User Identification stack for Apple HomeView.
Visual Age Estimation for Child Safety on Apple Platforms.
Gaze understanding in Camera & Photos, Accessibility.
Liveness assessment for IDs in Apple Wallet, and more.
You must have a proven track record of domain expertise and technical leadership in applied ML research.
You will partner closely with feature and product teams across the company to build use-case specific and feature enabling technologies in areas such as understanding visual identity, facial attributes, face liveness and anti-spoofing, eye tracking and gaze analysis.
You will leverage state-of-the-art techniques to develop highly efficient, real-time solutions where needed, and/or also leverage pre-trained large scale visual/multimodal foundation models to achieve state-of-the-art quality for specific downstream use-cases.
You will be interacting very closely with a variety of ML leaders, researchers, software engineers, hardware & design teams cross-functionally in order to build and ship new experiences based on your technologies.
Ensuring quality in the field, with an emphasis on fairness and model robustness would constitute an important part of the role.
Designing, implementing, and deploying state-of-the-art ML solutions for advanced face analysis and understanding.
Leverage pre-trained large scale visual/multimodal foundation models to solve feature specific needs via training adapters or distilling to smaller footprints as required
Effectively communicating results and insights gained to partners and leaders, providing clear and actionable recommendations.
Staying abreast with the latest trends, technologies, and best practices in computer vision, machine learning, and large scale foundation models.
Actively contributing to ML community at the company by disseminating research ideas and results, enhancing shared infrastructure, and mentoring fellow practitioners.
Minimum Qualifications
Masters, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, or Computer Engineering; similarly related fields, or comparable professional experience.
Extensive knowledge and experience in leveraging large scale foundation models including multi-modal LLMs or vision-language models, including adapting/distilling pre-trained models for downstream perception tasks.
Strong programing skills in Python and proficiency in toolkits like Pytorch or equivalent deep learning frameworks.
Proficiency in leveraging AI coding and productivity tools, to supercharge experimentation and model training iterations.
Preferred Qualifications
Strong background in research and innovation, demonstrated through publications in top-tier journals or conferences, patents, or impactful industry experience.
Experience in addressing challenges associated with the transition of a prototype into a shipping product.
Familiarity with challenges of developing algorithms that run efficiently on resource-constrained platforms.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, be comfortable presenting research to large audiences, and have the ability to work in multi-functional teams.

We’re looking for an ML Engineer to help build and scale the indexing infrastructure powering web and image search. The team runs both petabyte-scale offline batch pipelines and near-real-time indexing systems that turn web documents, images, and metadata into production-ready indexes.
We work across distributed computing, data processing, and storage, while partnering with crawling, ranking, ML, retrieval, and infrastructure teams to shape the long-term indexing strategy. This is a cross-functional role requiring strong technical depth, organizational influence, and the ability to drive complex, multi-team initiatives.
You’ll own both technical direction and execution for two core systems: large-scale offline indexing (distributed pipelines processing petabytes of content into production indexes) and fresh/near-real-time indexing (low-latency propagation of new or updated content). Responsibilities span architecture, scalability, reliability, and efficiency across billions of documents and images.
Success requires close collaboration across teams to resolve dependencies, make architecture tradeoffs, and drive large programs to completion, while acting as a key liaison to senior leadership on strategy, risks, and resourcing.
Lead and grow a team building large-scale web and image indexing infrastructure
Own architecture and execution for both offline batch pipelines and near-real-time indexing systems
Drive improvements in freshness, throughput, scalability, reliability, and efficiency
Enable rapid experimentation for search quality and ML teams introducing new signals
Build strong cross-team partnerships (crawling, ranking, ML, storage, serving) and align on architecture and delivery milestones
Represent the indexing org in leadership reviews, communicating strategy, progress, and tradeoffs
Recruit and develop engineers, fostering a culture of ownership and technical excellence
Minimum Qualifications
Significant experience building large-scale distributed systems or data infrastructure
Engineering management experience leading software teams
Strong grasp of distributed systems, large-scale data processing, and storage
Experience with distributed batch processing (e.g., MapReduce-style models)
Track record leading multi-team technical initiatives and influencing without direct authority
Strong communication skills for technical topics with senior leadership
BS in CS or related field, or equivalent experience
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with batch/streaming frameworks (Spark, Beam, Flink, Kafka, etc.)
Experience with distributed storage systems (Bigtable, HBase, Cassandra)
Background in search, information retrieval, or large-scale content processing
Experience with image processing, computer vision, or multimodal systems
Experience optimizing distributed systems for cost, latency, and throughput
Experience driving cross-org programs and presenting strategy to executive leadership
Track record developing senior engineers into technical leadership roles

We advance technology by relying on each other's strengths and skills to build something bigger than ourselves. For this reason, team culture is central to our values. We value social skills and integrity as much as technical craft.

Do you excel in a high-demand setting and exceed expectations, in an environment that requires time-management? The right person will prioritize tasks and complete assignments ahead of schedule. apple-200693798-0836.text:
At Apple, we create intuitive, intelligent experiences that enrich people's lives. We are seeking a Senior Human-Centered AI Researcher to help shape the next generation of software experiences across Apple's ecosystem. In this role, you will lead research that advances our understanding of how people interact with both emerging AI capabilities and established software experiences. Working closely with engineering, design, marketing, data science, and AI/ML modeling teams, you will define research strategies, uncover user needs and expectations, and translate behavioral insights into actionable recommendations that influence product direction, design, quality and ultimately shape the end customer experience.
Our team conducts human-centered research throughout the software and AI-feature development lifecycle, from understanding user needs and expectations to evaluating early prototypes and assessing product experience quality. We combine rigorous qualitative and quantitative methods to understand how people perceive, interact with, and experience software, including intelligent and adaptive systems.
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in experimental design, statistical analysis, and mixed-methods research, with the scientific judgment to select and adapt methodologies to complex product questions. You will independently lead research initiatives across multiple product areas, collaborating with cross-functional partners to identify critical research questions, establish meaningful evaluation criteria, and translate findings into actionable product recommendations.
This role requires the ability to communicate complex findings to diverse audiences, including senior leadership and executives, and directly influence product strategy and development priorities. You will also contribute to research strategy, advance methodological practices, and mentor other researchers.
Define and lead human-centered research strategies across multiple software and AI-powered experiences, identifying critical research questions and opportunities to inform product development.
Design and execute rigorous qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-methods studies, including controlled experiments, surveys, usability evaluations, interviews, longitudinal studies, and Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA).
Apply experimental design principles and appropriate statistical techniques to evaluate user behavior, perceptions, expectations, and experience quality.
Lead research throughout the software and AI-feature development lifecycle, from early user needs and expectations research through prototype evaluation, feature refinement, and product quality assessment.
Develop human-centered evaluation frameworks, experience metrics, and success criteria to assess usability, usefulness, reliability, and perceived quality of software and intelligent systems.
Partner closely with engineering, design, product marketing, data science, and AI/ML modeling teams to align research objectives with product and technical priorities, inform tradeoffs, and guide feature development.
Integrate insights from qualitative research, self-reported measures, experimental data, and behavioral telemetry to develop a comprehensive understanding of user experience.
Translate complex research findings into clear, compelling presentations and recommendations for cross-functional teams, senior leadership, and executives, directly influencing product direction and development decisions.
Provide technical and methodological leadership across multiple projects, mentoring researchers, developing scalable research approaches, and advancing research practices across the organization.
Minimum Qualifications
PhD in Cognitive Science, Experimental Psychology, Neuroscience, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field with substantial training in quantitative and qualitative research.
5+ years of relevant experience conducting human-centered research in technology or software product development.
Formal training and demonstrated expertise in experimental design, including hypothesis development, study design, sampling strategies, randomization, measurement, and interpretation of experimental results.
Strong proficiency in statistics including t-tests, analysis of variance (ANOVA), regression models, clustering techniques, factor analysis, mixed-effects models, repeated-measures analysis, or other multivariate approaches with the ability to select, apply, and interpret appropriate analyses for complex research questions.
Demonstrated expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, including survey design, usability testing, Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA), diary studies, field experiments, or other longitudinal and in-situ research programs.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leveraging AI-assisted tools and workflows across the research lifecycle, including but not limited to research design, data processing, qualitative and quantitative analysis, and synthesis of findings, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and validity.
Experience researching AI-powered products, generative AI, intelligent systems, or emerging software interaction paradigms.
Experience combining behavioral telemetry, self-reported measures, and qualitative findings to inform product decisions.
Proven ability to translate complex research findings into actionable recommendations and communicate effectively through presentations to senior leadership and executive audiences.
Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy, navigate ambiguous research questions, and provide methodological mentorship to other researchers.

apple-200685546-3337.text:
Apple Services Engineering (ASE), the team behind iCloud and Media services and the infrastructure that powers them, is looking for a Staff Security Engineer to partner with engineering teams to build AI-driven security assurance capabilities. You will collaborate with developers, site reliability engineers, and security teams to protect ASE services and design a secure foundation for services at Apple. Your work will include scaling assurance activities, including security risk assessments, threat modeling, and development of security standards. You will work with partner teams in security engineering, privacy, and offensive security to keep Apple's services secure for our users. If you love diving into complex technical systems, sharing security improvements, and making security better, we want to hear from you!
In this role, you will combine deep expertise in security architecture, threat modeling, security design review, and spec-driven development (SDD) with hands-on experience building sophisticated AI-powered systems. You will design and develop intelligent security assurance capabilities that leverage large language models, autonomous agents, and build organization–specific security context to identify and prevent meaningful security risk across complex systems and architectures.
You will also help define how security is incorporated into SDD practices, ensuring that security requirements, threat models, abuse cases, trust boundaries, controls, and verification criteria are established early and carried through the specification, implementation, testing, and development lifecycle.
This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of security assurance and applied-AI. You will partner closely with software engineers, architects, and product teams working at the forefront of agent technology, to understand emerging capabilities, influence how agentic systems are designed and developed, and integrate security throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
Architect, develop, and deploy AI-powered security assurance systems that automate and augment security design reviews, threat modeling, and architectural risk assessments
Define and implement security practices for spec-driven development, including security requirements, abuse cases, threat models, trust boundaries, control objectives, and security acceptance criteria
Integrate security analysis and verification into the SDD lifecycle so that security considerations are addressed during specification, design, implementation, testing, and change review
Build agentic workflows capable of analyzing complex system architectures and specifications, reasoning about security threats, identifying potential vulnerabilities, and producing actionable security findings
Implement advanced context-management approaches, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), persistent agent memory, and other techniques that enable AI systems to reason effectively within the organization's security environment
Apply evaluation frameworks to measure the accuracy, completeness, reliability, and security effectiveness of AI-generated assessments and SDD outputs
Integrate AI-driven assurance capabilities into engineering workflows and existing security infrastructure to expand security coverage without proportionally increasing manual review effort
Continuously evaluate emerging AI models, agent frameworks, and engineering techniques, identifying opportunities to improve security assurance capabilities
Partner with security engineers, architects, and engineering teams to translate complex security requirements and expert judgment into reusable, automated assurance capabilities
Minimum Qualifications
10 or more years of hands-on experience in security assurance, with demonstrated depth in security architecture, threat modeling, security design reviews, and security risk assessment.
Experience evaluating AI system performance, including reliability, correctness, failure, modes, and effectiveness against defined objectives.
Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language, API integration, and production software development.
Experience with LLM orchestration, agent tool use, retrieval systems, context engineering, and techniques for grounding AI outputs in trusted organizational data.
Experience incorporating security into spec-driven development, requirements engineering, secure design practices, or comparable structured software development methodologies.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred
Experience applying generative AI or agentic automation specific to security assurance, threat, modeling, architecture, reviews, vulnerability analysis, or spec-driven development.
Experience building enterprise knowledge systems using RAG, knowledge graphs, persistent memory, or hybrid retrieval techniques.
Experience in integrating AI agents with engineering tools, source code, repositories, architecture, documentation, specifications, requirements systems, and security assessment workflows.
Experience establishing traceability between specifications, security requirements, implementation artifacts, tests, and assurance evidence.

Apple builds products that are loved by people around the world—products that enrich lives by making powerful technology feel simple, intuitive, and accessible. Through deep integration of hardware, software, services, and design, we deliver end-to-end experiences that fit naturally into everyday life and work seamlessly across your devices and data. This is where ambitious ideas become real products, shipped at global scale and trusted by millions, and increasingly billions, of people.
Weʼre building Apple Intelligence to be the most personalized and integrated intelligence on the planet. Apple is a company people trust with their most personal information—from everyday communication to photos, health, and fitness—enabling us to build highly contextual experiences with uncompromising privacy & security.
Weʼre looking for software engineers to build experiences that harness cutting-edge technologies like AI, machine learning, and computer vision to solve difficult, high-impact problems at scale, in ways that feel effortless to our users. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, system software, and user experience, and aims to create features youʼd genuinely want to use. This is a rare opportunity to get in on the ground floor of something that will redefine how millions of people interact with their devices, while upholding Appleʼs core values of privacy, accessibility, and inclusion.
In this role, you will work across the stack - from the system software and frameworks to end-user interfaces - to build Apple Intelligence features that enrich peopleʼs lives. This is a highly cross-functional role working with design, algorithms, software, services, privacy, security, performance, and sometimes even HW / Silicon teams across Apple to engineer end-to-end solutions. You will need to work quickly and creatively to help demonstrate the viability of ideas and technologies while building robust, production-ready systems that millions of users will depend on. You will need to be comfortable writing Swift code, evaluating AI/ML algorithms for on-device integration and measuring and improving their quality through evals and prompt iteration, collaborating on user experience design, debugging complex cross-device interactions, and contributing to a culture of shipping high-quality production code. In addition to software engineering, you will also apply excellent UX intuition to identify and shape experience opportunities, iterate with design, and define technical requirements that drive development.
Prototypes early-stage concepts to validate feasibility and build the case for further investment.
Owns the engineering side of cross-functional initiatives from kickoff through delivery.
Solves technically difficult problems embedded within larger engineering efforts.
Engineers solutions spanning sensor or data-pipeline processing through AI/ML algorithms to end-user application logic.
Minimum Qualifications
BS / MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience
10+ years in software development
Rapid validation through hands-on execution — Experience quickly building prototypes to prove out viability, then using that work to secure buy-in and formal investment in larger initiatives.
End-to-end program ownership & executive representation — Experience owning the engineering side of cross-functional initiatives from kickoff through delivery.
Low-level-to-product technical range — Experience translating low-level, raw technical data (e.g., sensor or pipeline data) into the logic and decisions that directly shape a user-facing product.
Deep technical ownership — Experience being the go-to owner for solving specific, technically difficult problems.
Excellent programming and GenAI coding skills — Experience with an app programming language (preferably at least one of Swift, Objective-C, C++) and strong understanding of data structures, memory management, and concurrency, and comfort with development using GenAI coding tools.
Preferred Qualifications
Shipping user-facing features or products to production at scale
Developing for iOS/MacOS and/or using Apple system frameworks
Applied ML engineering experience building and shipping features using LLMs and/or ML algorithms, including on-device inference, building evals and data-driven validation, iterating on prompts and model behavior to improve quality over time, defining requirements, and collaborating with algorithm teams
Processing sensor data, (e.g. image/video, audio, motion), such as using computer vision / signal processing
Developing system software or frameworks, including API definition and performance optimization (particularly for resource constrained or real-time systems)
